summary: Enhance your skills with our Facility Management Professional Training. Gain essential knowledge and certifications to excel in facility management.
lede: Facility management training helps practitioners, career entrants and related professionals oversee building operations and assets. It develops practical skills for assessing facility needs and building systems, planning operations and maintenance, and managing facility projects from defining objectives to organizing resources. Learners also work with budgets and financial documents, and explore strategic planning and leadership for managing facility organizations.
audienceIntro: This course is tailored for individuals aiming to deepen their expertise in facility management. This course is designed for: Facility management practitioners looking to increase their depth of knowledge in foundational FM topics. Individuals transitioning into the FM profession. Related-industry practitioners such as architects, designers, and safety engineers. Facility-related product and service providers. Students entering the profession from colleges, universities, certificate or technical programs. Experienced FMs intending to pursue the CFM credential.
prerequisites: No prerequisites are required, though a background in facility management or a related field is beneficial.
